$comment: Two guards. Both force a manual approval prompt even when the session is running in bypass-permissions mode. Copy this file as-is; it needs no per-project editing.

PreToolUse.$comment: Outbound-mail gate. Any tool that can put a message in front of a real recipient requires an explicit human yes, per message. Widen this matcher if you wire in a different mail server — match on the server prefix, not on a memorised tool list.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Outgoing communication — must be manually approved before sending, even in bypass-permissions mode."}}'

PreToolUse.$comment: Destructive-shell gate. Requires jq on PATH.
